residuals.statement: No artifact in the authority chain contains a verbatim definitional sentence for 'selected-column read'. expected_selected_reads and expected_full_reads were introduced as bare numeric tokens.
residuals.consequence: Possibility A is a RECONSTRUCTION from origin, usage, structure and the absence of any contrary requirement. It is not a quotation.
residuals.recommended_handling: HQ should ratify the reconstruction explicitly rather than let it be inherited silently.

residuals.statement: Alt-B, the review that APPROVED the freeze, performed presence-and-consistency checking only (3a5b2cbc7) and never examined what a selected-column read measures.
residuals.consequence: The ceiling was approved without definitional scrutiny. This is why the term's unit has to be recovered structurally.

residuals.statement: Under A, full_reads=0 constrains invocation SCOPE, not physical I/O. A projection-configured read satisfies it while consuming the same bytes as a full read.
residuals.consequence: A reviewer who holds that the ceiling was meant to bound physical I/O would reject the rule in 05_ACCOUNTING_RULE_UNDER_A.json. If HQ so holds, the matter converts to B and an Astra decision is required.
residuals.falsification_test: Produce any authority artifact requiring unselected-column bytes or column-level I/O to be avoided. If one exists, A collapses to B or C.

residuals.statement: R9-SEL-03 remains open. The frozen decoder has no selected-read operation of either kind, and its iter_batches route issues an all-column chunked read that is a FULL READ under the meaning established here.
residuals.consequence: This determination does not implement the route. It says the usecols route, once implemented and requalified, may truthfully record selected_reads=1/full_reads=0 under A. Implementation and requalification remain outstanding.

residuals.statement: byte_counts_where_measurable remains UNBOUND in the governing evidence (HQ190-C ACC-09 grade '—').
residuals.consequence: Under A the physical read traffic of the selected invocation has no accepted numeric ceiling. R5 records it, but nothing bounds it yet.

residuals.statement: This lane performed ZERO source access, no source execution and no production mutation. All findings are documentary.
residuals.consequence: Nothing here qualifies any real source or authorises any access.
